id.description: A stable slug, usually from the website domain (ferncloud for ferncloud.example).

domain.description: The website's domain without www, used to match the same company across sources.

one_liner.description: What it does, in one line, from its own site or the fund's.

stage.description: The latest stage known; null when unknown.

status.description: What is true of the company now, whatever the fund holds. A source must say so for anything but active; null when no source says ("Exited in 2024" says nothing about the company).

fund_position.description: Whether the fund still holds a stake: held, exited, or null when unknown. Separate from status: a fund can exit a company that stays active.

hq.description: Headquarters city and country, as stated.

logo.description: The chosen logo: a link to its record in media ([[media/<id>]]).

profiles.description: Public profiles the fund's or company's own pages link to. Never searched for elsewhere.

lead_partner.description: The fund's partner on this company: [[team/<id>]].

first_invested_on.description: When the fund first invested, when the exact date is known.

first_invested_year.description: The year the fund first invested, when only the year is known.

entry_round.description: The round the fund entered in, as the source writes it ("Seed", "Series A", "Secondary").

ownership_percent.description: The fund's ownership as last reported, a percentage (8.5 means 8.5%).

ownership_as_of.description: When that ownership figure was true.

reporting_cadence.description: How often the company is expected to send an update.

on_fund_site.description: Whether the fund's own portfolio page lists it now.

exit_note.description: For an exit or shutdown: what happened, as the source states it.

source_paths.description: Where this came from: the web pages (https://…) or wiki paths it was read from. Evidence, not ownership.

checked_at.description: When the sources were last read for this record, in UTC.

content.description: Optional Markdown writing about this record. Use this before creating a separate detail page.
